introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Pure Mathematics With Statistics, Paper 3 (0770/3), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2021. Time allowed: THREE HOURS.**

Full marks may be obtained for answers to ALL questions. Mathematical formulae and tables produced by the GCE Board are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving the answer at each stage. Electronic calculators may be used. Start each question on a fresh page. The scan contains 8 questions (13 marks each), all compulsory.
enonce_intro_markdown:
It is believed that there is a relationship between the ages and the monthly income of the employees of a firm. The table below shows the ages, $x$, (in years) and the monthly income, $y$, (in tens of thousands) FCFA, of eight employees of the firm.

| Age, $x$ (in years) | 32 | 29 | 33 | 35 | 31 | 28 | 36 | 30 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly income, $y$ ($\times$ 10,000 FCFA) | 27 | 18 | 28 | 29 | 23 | 20 | 30 | 27 |

Calculate, to three decimal places,

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) the product-moment correlation coefficient of the age and income.
(b) the equation of the least squares regression line of monthly income on age.
questions.corrige_markdown:
The regression line of $y$ on $x$ is $y = a + bx$ with

$$b = \frac{S_{xy}}{S_{xx}} = \frac{74.5}{55.5} = 1.3423\ldots, \qquad \bar{x} = \frac{254}{8} = 31.75, \quad \bar{y} = \frac{202}{8} = 25.25$$

$$a = \bar{y} - b\bar{x} = 25.25 - 1.34234 \times 31.75 = -17.3694\ldots$$

**$y = -17.369 + 1.342\,x$** (3 d.p.), where $y$ is in tens of thousands of FCFA: each extra year of age adds about $1.342 \times 10\,000 \approx 13\,423$ FCFA to the monthly income in this model.

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) the minimum sum of squares of residuals for the regression line of income on age.
questions.corrige_markdown:
The least squares line minimises $\sum (y_i - a - bx_i)^2$, and the minimum value is

$$\sum e^2 = S_{yy} - \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}} = S_{yy}\,(1 - r^2) = 135.5 - \frac{74.5^2}{55.5} = 135.5 - 100.0045 = 35.4955\ldots$$

**Minimum sum of squares of residuals $= 35.495$ (3 d.p.)** (in the units of $y^2$, that is $(10\,000\text{ FCFA})^2$).
